title: The line y = x + 1 meets the circle x² + y² = 13
caption: Substituting gives x² + x − 6 = 0, so x = −3 or 2: the line cuts the circle at (−3, −2) and (2, 3), both at distance √13 from the centre.
alt: A circle of radius √13 centred at the origin and the line y = x + 1 meeting it at (−3, −2) and (2, 3).
description: The circle x² + y² = 13 has centre O and radius √13 ≈ 3.61.
The line y = x + 1 crosses the y-axis at (0, 1).
Solving gives the two points (−3, −2) and (2, 3), each on both the circle and the line.
